title: The Underground Railroad
author: Colson Whitehead
summary: Cora, enslaved on a Georgia plantation, escapes north on a literal underground railroad. Colson Whitehead reimagines each state she reaches as a different version of American racism, while a slave catcher pursues her.
readIf: you want inventive historical fiction that confronts slavery directly.
skipIf: you cannot read graphic depictions of brutality.
